- Use app to play duet with you. Enter the duet notes using Piano Exam Create app and export here.

- Use safari browser to download and practise any midi song.

- Use Synthesia Create app to make exam pieces and export here for practise. It takes about 3 minutes to enter all the notes for a grade 1 piece. 

- Loop the song. Tap the measure number to set the start and stop loop. It will repeat the loop. You can remove the loop by tapping the measure number again.

- Use 2 fingers pinch to zoom. And 2 fingers drag to pan. And 1 finger upward swipe to rewind the music sheet. 

Have fun!
